summary: Schools Beyond Screens & Fairplay urge the FCC to keep E‑Rate funding intact while tightening EdTech safety, privacy, and effectiveness, and to pause generative AI in schools. Schools Beyond Screens opposes cuts to E‑Rate connectivity funding, calls for independent AI vetting, and supports parental opt‑out and other safeguards without reducing broadband subsidies.
